title: Keep recursive reads within the mount

context.hint: Apply one read boundary to direct operations and recursive filesystem browsing.
context.surface: A read-only filesystem browser offers direct file operations, directory listing and content search under a configured mount.
assumptions: The configured mount is the read boundary.
Use disposable directories and synthetic files to check the policy.

review.invariant: Directory listings and content search avoid reading or descending into entries whose resolved targets lie outside the configured mount.
review.verification: Use disposable file and directory links alongside ordinary files. Verify the documented handling of denied targets and confirm that ordinary listing and search still return expected results.

source_observation.summary: The working copy skipped outside links and preserved in-root results. Five targeted tests and all sixteen module tests passed, including on a fresh copy after applying the repair. The generated scripts were exercised locally. Live remote transport and the separate bridge service were outside the executed checks.
